justification: The evidence reports strong overall performance metrics, but fairness cannot be attributed from overall accuracy, false-positive/false-negative rates, or calibration alone. No group-specific error rates are provided, and the demographic composition of the validation dataset is unknown, so there is no basis to assess whether outcomes were equitable across groups in the deployment context. The complaint count is too limited and unresolved to support a fairness attribution.
evidence_used: Group-specific error rates are not reported in the validation documentation
Demographic composition of the validation dataset is not included in the documentation available to the evaluator
During the first eight weeks of limited deployment, 14,310 applications were processed
Seven complaints concerning lending decisions were registered; none had completed investigation at the date of evaluation
limitations: No group-specific fairness metrics are available
No demographic composition for the validation dataset is available
Complaint investigations were incomplete at the time of evaluation
The evidence does not establish fairness in the described deployment context
